content:
As Best Buy's massive 60th-anniversary sale event unfolds, this week's 25% off AirPods Pro 3 deal continues, AirPods Max 2 is $120 off across all five colors, and AirTag 2 remains at its all-time low price. However, today's 9to5Toys lunchbreak deals also feature new recommendations. If you move fast, Apple's official refurbished store has restocked the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro for as low as $1,099, available in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue; meanwhile, we've also tracked a batch of brand-new M5 Pro MacBook Pro deals with $400 off. The $100 off Apple Watch Series 11 deal has also returned, starting at just over $250, plus Twelve South accessory deals—including Find My chargers and the Curve Nano MagSafe stand at new lows on Amazon. All deals are listed below.

AirPods deals drop again with up to $120 off: AirPods Pro 3 25% off, more

After a whole summer of steady discounts on Apple's latest AirPods lineup, nearly every model has dropped further today. The highly sought-after AirPods Pro 3 is now at one of its best prices ever with a 25% discount, the AirPods 4 with ANC has also fallen to its lowest price in months, and AirPods Max 2 dropped further this morning by another $120.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (was $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (was $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (was $129)

AirTag 2 returns to some historical lows from $22 for single and 4-pack

  • AirTag 2 $24 (was $29) | Amazon
  • AirTag 2 $24 (was $29) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 'Excellent' Open-Box $20 (was $29 new) | Best Buy
  • AirTag 2 4-Pack $89 (was $99)

Best Buy launches one-day anniversary LG deals: TVs from $330, 2026 OLEDs $600 off, more

Back in stock: Cheapest M5 MacBook Air via Apple Refurbished Store at $1,099 (move fast), $200 off newer pricing

Update 8/20: This deal is now back in stock at $1,099, available in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This deal likely won't last long—as always—Apple's official refurbished store has restocked the cheapest 13-inch M5 MacBook Pro for as low as $1,099 with free shipping, available in Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This particular configuration sells out extremely fast every time Apple restocks it, so don't hesitate if you're interested—after all, this is the cheapest M5 MacBook Air price available.

Apple's official certified refurbished store is now selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage for $1,099 with free shipping. As mentioned, at the time of writing, Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue color options are available.

This machine was originally priced at $1,299, which is $200 lower than the newer pricing.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (was $1,299 new)
  • Midnight, Starlight, and Sky Blue

Friendly reminder, all products from Apple's official refurbished store include the following coverage:

  • Apple one-year limited warranty
  • Apple 14-day return policy
  • Eligible for AppleCare
  • Apple's rigorous refurbishment process before sale

For comparison, Amazon's price for this brand-new model is very close to the $1,299 MSRP, with the Silver version as low as $1,240.

Amazon still offers M5 Pro MacBook Pro deals with $400 off these configurations

As part of its 60th-anniversary promotion, Best Buy held a special one-day Apple deals event yesterday. The highlight was $400 off two M5 Pro MacBook Pro configurations, but Amazon today still retains these two deals for those who missed out.

Amazon is still selling these two 14-inch 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro models at $400 below pricing—one with base CPU/GPU specs, the other with an upgraded 18-core CPU/20-core GPU.

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (was $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,799 (was $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

These are indeed the same deals we recommended yesterday, but they also look very likely to last only one day—Best Buy said so, and it's unclear whether Amazon will follow suit. Overall, Amazon could end these deals at any time, but they remain valid at the time of writing, and we want to make sure everyone notices these deals.

This 48GB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $400 off today

B&H is now selling the Apple 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB RAM and 1TB storage for $2,699 with free shipping.

This is the $3,099 configuration, which is $400 lower than buying directly from Apple.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary sale $100 off, Best Buy open-box deals from $254

Although yesterday's 24-hour 60th-anniversary Apple deals have ended, there are still some major deals ongoing. Besides 25% off AirPods Pro 3, $120 off AirPods Max 2, and Apple's latest AirTag 2 returning to historical lows, we've also tracked that all the cheapest Apple Watch Series 11 models are $100 off on Amazon and Best Buy—you can even find 'Excellent' open-box models as low as $254.

Amazon is again selling all base 46mm Series 11 models for $329 with free shipping. That's $100 below the $429 pricing, with all four case colors available at the discounted price.

However, stock for the smaller and cheaper 42mm models is now nearly sold out. This is where Best Buy comes in.

Best Buy is running its massive 60th-anniversary promotion, with all 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 models in stock and selling at $100 below pricing.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (was $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (was $429)

Although the price difference isn't huge, I also want to point out the 'Excellent' open-box deal for the Jet Black 42mm model—you can get it for $253.99 with free shipping, which is $145 lower than the new device pricing. Although it's only $45 cheaper than buying a brand-new unit at the moment, $45 is no small amount, and this is the lowest price we can find from reputable sources.

Amazon's best quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models are $220 off today (matching Prime Day deals)

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (was $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (was $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (was $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (was $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (was $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (was $1,299 new)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple Refurbished Store featured recommendations, you can get a fully functional iPhone 16 with a 1-year Apple warranty starting from $699, and a 1TB 16 Pro Max for $1,269—which is $330 cheaper than a comparable 17 Pro Max and $130 cheaper than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (up to $330 cheaper than 17 series)

Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the most beautiful MagSafe stands I've seen, now available for $27 (was $35)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Twelve South full-featured braided PowerCord USB-C charger now drops to $16.50 (45% off)
  • 5TB for only $180? Rare deal drops WD Elements portable hard drive to lowest price since storage product price hikes (today only)
  • Woot's latest promotion features Keychron mechanical keyboards from $20, with up to 64% off
  • This 14-in-1 Anker Prime docking station is $100 off, one of the new lows
  • This Anker 8-outlet power strip with USB and surge protection is $22 today
  • Upgrade your home theater with the Govee TV Backlight 3 Lite kit, featuring dynamic lighting effects, from as low as $110, more styles from $60
  • Petcube Cam 360 helps you monitor your pets 360 degrees with two-way talk, now from as low as $35
  • Govee's latest Floor Lamp 3 Lite with Matter support from as low as $85, other models from $80 with up to 47% off
  • Anker Nano 100W three-port charger with 5-foot cable is $36 today

Amazon now offers $120 off AirPods Max 2 in all five colors (one of the best prices ever)

This week's massive 60th-anniversary promotion is bringing one of the best prices ever for Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now selling all five colors at $120 below pricing.

Amazon is now selling Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429 with free shipping.

Compared to the previous generation's same $549 price, this saves you $120, making it the best price we can currently find from reputable retailers in brand-new condition.

Best Buy is indeed selling the 'Excellent' open-box Midnight Black version for $403.99 with free shipping, which is cheaper, but may not be enough to make people give up buying a brand-new unit.

Apple has launched a true next-generation AirPods Max this year, rather than just giving the previous generation a new shell and switching to a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, Apple won't be updating its over-ear products at next month's new product launch, so what we're seeing this week is $120 off Apple's over-ear headphones (likely the newest and best model for some time to come).

Previously, only one promotional event offered a lower price, which was Prime Day earlier this summer, when the price was $30 lower than today's deal price—but stock was also quite limited and unstable during the four-day promotion.

Anker 45W Nano smart display charger still maintains its $26 low price, but this bundle costs only $4 more and includes a USB-C cable

As part of its ongoing 60th-anniversary promotion, Best Buy is selling the white version of the Anker 45W Nano smart display charger for $29.99 with free shipping, and includes a Nano USB-C cable. This is only about $4 more than the charger's current discounted price of $25.99 with free shipping, which remains unchanged at Amazon and Best Buy. Considering the Nano USB-C cable included in this bundle typically sells for around $18, you're basically paying only $4 for the cable, making it an extremely good value. More details below.

  • Anker Nano 45W GaN Smart Display Charger $25.99 (was $40)
  • Black
  • Blue
  • Orange
  • White

The Anker 45W Nano charger with built-in smart display has always been popular, as it can identify supported devices like iPhone and iPad Pro models and adjust power delivery accordingly. The screen also displays real-time charging information and animations, allowing you to quickly check status while your device is charging. It features a top-mounted USB-C port providing up to 45W output, plus 180-degree foldable prongs for daily use or travel. Available in four color options, including orange that pairs perfectly with Apple Cosmic Orange devices. This specific deal bundle costs only $4 more to include an Anker Nano USB-C cable. This braided cable supports up to 240W charging and 480Mb/s data transfer, making it a solid choice overall, and if you're also looking to buy a new cable to charge your phone, this is an excellent value pick.

Other noteworthy Anker deals

  • Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 MagSafe foldable charger $100 (was $150)
  • Anker Prime 3-in-1 25W Qi2.2 charging stand with display $135 (was $230)
  • Anker 160W 3-port Prime charger with display and touch control $116 (was $150)
